notes: Samsung prints Dimension & Weight as WIDTH x HEIGHT x DEPTH; mapped to height/width/depth accordingly. Samsung never publishes a crease shape (teardrop/U) for any Flip, so hinge.crease is null throughout. hinge.max_angle_deg left null: Samsung states Flex Mode working angles, not a maximum hinge angle. CURRENT-GENERATION Galaxy Z Flip as of 2026-09-13. Materials come from the Samsung US product page, not the press release, which mentions neither Armor Aluminum nor Victus. Back material not stated - null.
